vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: todayhistory
Version: 1.0.2

The skill is a standard API wrapper for the Jisu Data 'Today in History' service (api.jisuapi.com). The Python script (todayhistory.py) safely handles user input via JSON parsing and performs legitimate HTTP GET requests using the provided API key from environment variables, with no signs of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or command injection.

llm.summary: The skill is coherent: it runs a included Python script that calls the Jisu 'Today in History' API using a single required JISU_API_KEY and does not request unrelated credentials or system access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match behavior: the included script queries https://api.jisuapi.com/todayhistory/query. Declared requirements (python3 and JISU_API_KEY) are reasonable and proportional to this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs only to run the bundled Python script with a JSON body. The script only reads the JISU_API_KEY environment variable and the provided JSON, performs an HTTP GET to the documented Jisu API, and prints the JSON result. It does not access other files, system-wide config, or send data to unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) which minimizes installation risk. The script imports the third-party 'requests' library but the skill does not declare or install that dependency — runtime will fail if 'requests' is not present. There are no downloads or archive extraction steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single API credential (JISU_API_KEY) is required and used. That is appropriate for a service that requires an app key; no unrelated secrets or numerous env vars are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not forced-always, does not modify other skills or system settings, and has ordinary autonomous-invocation settings. It does not request elevated persistence or unusual privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: call the Jisu TodayHistory API and return results. Before installing, ensure you trust the Jisu provider and are comfortable giving this skill an app key (JISU_API_KEY). Use a key with limited scope/quotas if possible, keep the key secret, and be aware of rate limits and billing on the Jisu side. Also ensure the runtime has the Python 'requests' library installed (the skill does not install dependencies itself). If you need stronger guarantees about data handling, review the Jisu service privacy/security docs.
